lines.en: Shield first. The road opens itself.

lines.zh: 我的靴子把石子碾成粉。
lines.en: My boots grind stones into powder.
Move. Do not block my path.
Iron bits jingle in my pocket.
I make the road creak under my weight.
A heavy shield is good for the arms.
Who is ahead? I will barge through.
The plank road groans under me.
I bring wind when I walk. And dirt.
Do not walk so close. I turn fast.
Even my shadow is wider than yours.
I know this dirt road blindfolded.
I wipe the shield with my sleeve.
Seven scratches on this shield.
Who wants to test strength with me?
I am hungry. Let me grind my teeth.
I flip iron bits and catch them.
Standing too long makes my knees ache.
I count the emeralds in my pocket.
This shield is too shiny. It needs dirt.
Nobody coming? Then I hit the wall.
I tighten the bracer one notch.
Wind blows dust down my collar.
Hmph. This place is far too quiet.
I scrape rust off the shield rim.
My shoulder is stiff. Two rotations.

lines.zh: 我把盾当桌子，搁着半个面包。
lines.en: I use my shield as a table for half a loaf.
These gloves are worn through again.
You stand there like a fence post.
Let me see how sturdy you are.
Where is your shield? None? A pity.
I have my eye on you. Do not look away.
That frame of yours falls in one shove.
Your eyes are shaking. I can see it.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿太小了。
lines.en: That thing you hold is far too small.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，像看一堵墙。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you like a wall.
Measuring the gap? So am I.
I will remember that look of yours.
Do not hide. I am watching you.
Your boot soles are worn flat.
Bring another. I will barge you both.
You do not smell of iron at all.
Hurts? This is nothing.
My shield took half of that.
You hit off-center. Again.
I did not give half an inch. Look closely.
I owe you one for that punch.
Not the shield. The shield does nothing.
I bite down and stay quiet.
Thick skin. I am used to it.
Your swing has weight. I admit it.
One more. Try it.
Bread? Not enough to fill a tooth gap.
Give me the iron. I will patch my shield.
Emeralds yes. Skip the bread.
What are you doing with that carrot?

lines.zh: 我不吃软的，我要嚼硬的。
lines.en: I do not eat soft things. I chew hard ones.
Keep that food for yourself.
Iron ingots smell better than meat. Truly.
Stop waving it. I do not chase food.
Just toss the iron bits over.
I want something I can smash.
Bump me? Your bones are bold.
Stand firm. I do not apologize.
You bounced off. I barely pushed.
The shield rim caught you, did it not?
Out of the way. My brakes broke long ago.
Consider that a greeting.
You made my shield ring.
Do not press so close. It is warm.
I turn sideways and you roll away.
My feet did not move. You backed off.
Let me lean on your shield a while.
Let us charge each other. See who is harder.
I will take the front for you.
Your hands are steady. My arms are strong.
When it is over, we split the iron bits.
I will stand guard. You rest.
If you fall, I carry you.
Side by side, nothing can barge through.
Your name is too long. I will just say you.

lines.zh: 咱俩的盾，划痕要一样多。
lines.en: Our shields should have equal scratches.
Dropped? Then it is mine.
This iron can patch a shield corner.
I bend to pick it up, shield and all.
The emerald goes in my pocket.
Pick it up and blow the dust off.
Who dropped it? They do not want it.
Can this thing hit someone?
I weigh it in my hand. Heavy enough.
A little thing. Into the pocket.

lines.zh: 我捡东西从不弯腰两次。
lines.en: I never bend twice for one thing.
You. Yes, you. Stand still.
I raise my shield. You should run.
I am going to barge you. Fair warning.
Do not move. I charge fast.
This round, I pick you.
You crossed a line. Mine.
I push the shield forward.
Here I come. Do not blink.
You cannot stop my shoulder.
I roar once. Then you know.
Target locked. Starting the run.
You retreat. I chase.
I measured your position.
This time not the wall. You.
I crouch low, shield over my face.
One step, two. I speed up.
The more you back off, the faster I go.
My breath sounds like a bellows.
The shield edge aims at your chest.
I wait for the moment you raise your hand.
Circling will not help. I can block it.
I shift my weight to the front foot.
Do you hear the iron jingling?
I bite down and stare at you.

lines.zh: 把弓放下，那玩意儿烦人。
lines.en: Drop the bow. That thing annoys me.
Three more steps is enough.
I bang the shield on the ground twice.
You are waiting. So am I.

lines.zh: 我把盾举高，正好挡住你的眼。
lines.en: I raise the shield to block your eyes.
The shield face meets your cheek.
I barge you. That is not a punch.
The floor rings with that one.
My fist is quicker than my shield.
You stagger three steps. I laugh.
I crash through your guard.
The shield rim catches your knee.
I pound your shoulder. Gently.
Whatever you held went flying.
Again. I am not even warm yet.
I rise from behind the dirt slope.
First, dust off the shield.
Who is here? Give me a name.
I crushed a brick underfoot.
This place is roomy enough to rampage.
I cinch my bracer tight.
I am late. Bumped into someone on the way.
The wind smells of rust. I like it.
I stand in the middle of the road, waiting.
I took this shield. Do not touch it.
I roll my cuffs up.
Nice weather for barging.
I step out of the shade, slowly.
Another thing worth ramming.
Hot. Even the shield face burns.
The shield hit first. Good shield.
Water pours down my collar. Unpleasant.
The blast flips me. Shield still on.
An arrow sticks in the shield like a thorn.
This magic feels sticky. Disgusting.
Too hungry to lift the shield.
Thunder leaves my ears ringing.
Nothing to stand on here. I hate it.
